steps.name: Public Grievance Cell, Directorate General of Employment (DGE), Ministry of Labour and Employment
steps.channel: Email: Pgcell.dge@gmail.com | Address: Room No.6, Shram Shakti Bhawan, Rafi Marg, New Delhi-110001
steps.when_to_use: If the complaint regarding central employment schemes or Ministry services is unresolved.

steps.name: CPGRAMS (Centralized Public Grievance Redress And Monitoring System)
steps.when_to_use: If the grievance remains unresolved by EPFO or the Ministry of Labour & Employment within a reasonable time.

note: Ensure that your UAN is active and that your employer has properly credited month-on-month PF contributions, as eligibility for scheme benefit transfers relies on correct EPFO registration details.
